verdict.rationale: Mailgun publishes a public Postman workspace with collections covering all its APIs. A Postman collection is a machine-readable, importable API description, which approximates an OpenAPI-equivalent spec. However, the probe found no OpenAPI or Swagger document at any standard path, and llms.txt is a documentation map rather than an API spec. missing for 10: a downloadable OpenAPI/Swagger spec file, documented spec download location, confirmation the Postman collection is exportable as a standalone schema, independent corroboration

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can download a machine-readable API spec (OpenAPI or equivalent)

citations.quote: Import all Mailgun APIs into Postman for easy testing and integration. Our public workspace includes organized collections with examples, environment variables, and ready-to-use requests.
